verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a community member quoting Morph's privacy policy: the Enterprise tier does not use submitted code for anything beyond the immediate request, while the Free tier may be used for training. The commenter also questions whether paying non-enterprise users are trained on. Protection from training therefore appears to exist only at the Enterprise tier and is evidenced secondhand. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the data-use policy, a self-serve training opt-out for free and paid tiers, clarity on paid non-enterprise tiers, and coverage of non-code data such as chat and Reflex training examples.
